name: Imagenae: Holy Grail War
introduction:
▌ After the event "Imagenae: Holy Grail War" begins, Trailblazers can participate in Trailblaze Continuance and the collaboration event gameplay. The collaboration characters have no English voiceovers. You may switch to another voiceover language if preferred.

▌ "Imagenae: Holy Grail War"
◆ Overview ◆
● A golden rain falls. A Holy Grail, stolen. Somewhere in the shadows beyond the Phantasmoon's reach, you'll step onto the battlefield of the Imagenae Holy Grail War, accompanied by Rin Tohsaka, a mage from another world...
◆ Event Rules ◆
● In "Fate/Star Rail Night," the Trailblazer joins the Imagenae Holy Grail War, gathering scattered Treasures and heading into battle equipped with Mystic Codes.

▌ Fate Gift
● During the event, Trailblazers who consume a cumulative total of 200 Star Rail Special Passes across any Version 4.4 Warp event can claim the reward after the Collaboration Warp begins.
● The total number of "Star Rail Special Passes" consumed is shared across all Warp events in Version 4.4.
● This reward can only be claimed once during the event.

▌ Fate Contract: Renewal
● During the event, all Trailblazers at Trailblaze Level 3 or above can immediately select and receive the limited collaboration 5-star character Gilgamesh or Archer after logging in.
